summary: A Quote subscription on the NIFTY index: the quote packet gives an index frame with the previous close from Dhan's previous-close packet and the change worked out against it.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

The web sends Dhan's trade time in epoch seconds as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends ltt in ms and Dhan's last_trade_time in seconds, as the web does.
deviations.ref: dhan_adapter.py:900; feed::dialect (Dhan last_trade_time in seconds, openalgo#2377)

deviations.reason: The web's index quote carries Dhan's (zero) last_quantity; the desktop's index frame leaves the quantity fields out, as the recorded Zerodha index transcript does. A field the broker sent must be present (lane wire, presence of every field).

The web's index quote carries Dhan's (zero) average_price; the desktop's index frame leaves the quantity fields out, as the recorded Zerodha index transcript does. A field the broker sent must be present (lane wire, presence of every field).

The web's index quote carries Dhan's (zero) total_buy_quantity; the desktop's index frame leaves the quantity fields out, as the recorded Zerodha index transcript does. A field the broker sent must be present (lane wire, presence of every field).

The web's index quote carries Dhan's (zero) total_sell_quantity; the desktop's index frame leaves the quantity fields out, as the recorded Zerodha index transcript does. A field the broker sent must be present (lane wire, presence of every field).
The desktop's index frames carry the change since the previous close, as the recorded Zerodha index transcript does; the web's Dhan adapter sends no change.
